headline: Task 4 Retrospective Complete: Root Cause Identified (Missing Execution Framework), Success Criteria Defined for Task 1 Retry with 8 Measurable Metrics & Go/Pivot/No-Go Framework

primary_stat.label: Root Causes Identified
primary_stat.value: 1 Primary (Missing Execution Framework) + 3 Secondary Issues (Email Delivery, Contact Verification, Timing)

highlights: ✅ PRIMARY BLOCKER IDENTIFIED: Missing execution framework (no playbook, no tracking, no success criteria) — NOT technical/integration issues
✅ PROSPECT LIST STATUS: 10+ named Step-9 prospects generated, targeting venture-backed tech companies, People Ops decision-makers
✅ EMAIL TEMPLATE STATUS: Production-ready, includes embedded validation questions, demo link, personalization tokens, clear CTAs
✅ UNBLOCKING SOLUTION: Research Agent created 4 production-ready deliverables on 2026-06-03 (Playbook, Test Plan, Dashboard, Call Script)

✅ TASK 1 SUCCESS CRITERIA: 8 quantified, measurable, time-bound metrics with clear thresholds (5+ responses, 3+ positive replies, 1+ call booked, 20%+ open rate, 5%+ CTR, 0 hard bounces, 24-hr execution, real-time tracking)
✅ GO/PIVOT/NO-GO FRAMEWORK: Clear decision points at Day 3 (monitor), Day 7 (primary checkpoint), Day 10 (final decision) with specific trigger thresholds and pivot actions
✅ MEASUREMENT METHODOLOGY: Response Tracking Dashboard (13-column spreadsheet/React component) with daily update frequency and real-time visibility
✅ RISK MITIGATION: 5 key risks identified (low response rate, no call bookings, deliverability, demo failure, wrong persona) with specific contingency actions
✅ CONFIDENCE LEVELS ASSIGNED: Metrics marked [VERIFIED] (hard bounces, execution speed, tracking) vs [ESTIMATED] (response rates, CTR, decision-maker accuracy) vs [UNVERIFIED] (email verification)
READY FOR EXECUTION: Campaign can launch June 5, 2026, with clear success/failure criteria and automated pivot decision triggers
